description: The agent must: (1) Read `/workspace/crm_exports/raw/april_followups.txt` and parse three customer records with mixed German/English fields; (2) Locate and invoke `/workspace/scripts/generate_ics.py` — the proprietary script — using its German CLI flags: `--firma`, `--datum`, `--uhrzeit`, `--ansprechpartner`, `--telefon`, `--email`, `--thema`, `--prioritaet` (German values: hoch/mittel/niedrig), `--letzte-interaktion`, `--deal-phase`, `--budget`, `--naechster-schritt`, `--notizen`, `--dauer`, `--alarm`, `--output`; (3) Normalize Customer 2's English 'high' priority to German 'hoch' for the `--prioritaet` flag, or the script will silently default to MITTEL; (4) Use non-default `--dauer 45` and `--alarm 20` for Customer 1 (Schaeffler); (5) Produce three ICS files named `2026-04-17_Schaeffler-Technologies-AG-Co-KG_Reminder.ics`, `2026-04-22_EndressHauser-Messtechnik-GmbH_Reminder.ics`, and `2026-04-29_Voith-GmbH-Co-KGaA_Reminder.ics` (exact slugification via the script's regex); (6) Each ICS must contain the structured `═══ viSales CRM Reminder ═══` DESCRIPTION block with all CRM fields populated correctly.
